limitations: AWS documents recent activity publication usually within four hours; this run polls report jobs for at most 60 seconds and does not wait for that publication window.
No account-wide policies, SCPs, root settings, or unrelated entities are inspected or modified.
Session expiration is not accelerated on AWS; distinct live role sessions test job ownership, not elapsed credential expiration.
Immediate post-creation credentials and post-policy-revocation responses include bounded IAM propagation observations marked propagation_pending; subsequent reads show stable authorization.
No FAILED report job, elapsed credential expiration, report aging, or activity publication after four hours was observed. These are not inferred from successful job creation.
ListPoliciesGrantingServiceAccess returned 200 namespace rows without truncation in the bounded graph. Its implicit policy-count pagination threshold was not reached.
CLI-only parameter failures were discarded; signed Query follow-ups preserve actual AWS service validation errors.

Pending managed-policy report retained the old default document while a new default version was already active and job status remained IN_PROGRESS. This establishes a snapshot before job completion, without asserting a precise internal worker scheduling boundary.

GetServiceLastAccessedDetails with omitted MaxItems returned 200 rows and IsTruncated:true for the allow-all policy, despite the primary documentation describing a default of100; the with-entities default page size was not reached.
reproduction: Run scripts/aws/iam_last_access_probe.py for the combined owned graph and controls. --phase selection|followup|edges|pending|pending-policy|report-controls|entities --output PATH runs one bounded phase. --phase names --output testdata/aws/iam/last_access_service_names.json captures the complete service display-name catalogue.

documented_semantics.activity_publication: Recent activity usually appears within four hours; reports must be regenerated for updated data.
documented_semantics.tracking: At least400days of authenticated access attempts, including denied calls. Tracked action metadata covers supported management actions; PassRole and data-plane actions are excluded.
documented_semantics.job_owner: Same IAM user across access keys, or exact temporary role/federated session.
documented_semantics.source_scope: User/group/role/managed policy permissions only; resource policies, ACLs, Organizations policies, permissions boundaries and session policies are excluded.
documented_semantics.observed_entity_snapshot: Completed reports freeze membership IDs. WithEntities resolves current name/path and excludes deleted identities; group membership removals/additions and managed-policy attachment changes do not rewrite the membership snapshot.
